title: Bihar BSEB DELED Result 2026
postName: Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) Examination Result 2026
vacancyDetails: Result of BSEB D.El.Ed. examinations for enrolled teacher training candidates in Bihar
qualification: Candidates enrolled in BSEB D.El.Ed. programme as per board rules
applicationFee: As paid during exam form (if any)
selectionProcess: Theory / Practical Examination → Result Declaration → Marksheet / Certificate process
documentsRequired: Roll number / registration number; admit card details for result login
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.biharboardonline.bihar.gov.in or official BSEB result link
2. Open D.El.Ed. Result 2026
3. Enter roll number / registration details
4. Download / print scorecard
5. Collect marksheet as per BSEB / institute instructions
shortDescription: Bihar BSEB D.El.Ed. Result 2026 declared. Check roll-wise result on the official BSEB portal.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has declared the D.El.Ed. (Diploma in Elementary Education) Result 2026.

Candidates can check subject-wise marks using roll number / registration credentials on the official BSEB result website.

After result

  • Download scorecard printout
  • Verify name, roll number and marks
  • Follow institute instructions for marksheet / certificate

For any discrepancy, contact the board through official channels only.
